Record Class RenderContext

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.trevlar.menukit.core.RenderContext
Record Components:
graphics - the graphics handle
originX - screen-space X of the element's containing content origin (the panel's content area after padding). The element adds its own childX to position itself.
originY - screen-space Y of the element's containing content origin
mouseX - screen-space mouse X, or -1 if no input dispatch
mouseY - screen-space mouse Y, or -1 if no input dispatch
public record RenderContext(net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphicsExtractor graphics, int originX, int originY, int mouseX, int mouseY) extends Record
Render-time context passed to every PanelElement.render(RenderContext). Bundles the graphics handle, the element's containing content origin, and the current mouse position.

Works across all three rendering contexts:

  • Inventory menus and standalone screens — full context including live mouse coordinates for hover detection.
  • HUDs — mouseX and mouseY are -1, signalling that no input dispatch is happening. hasMouseInput() returns false; isHovered(int, int, int, int) returns false uniformly.

The -1 sentinel for "no input dispatch" is a deliberate convention, not a bug — HUDs render without input routing per library doctrine. Consumers should use hasMouseInput() and isHovered(int, int, int, int) rather than inspecting the raw coordinates.

This record is the single parameter for PanelElement.render(RenderContext), replacing flat parameter lists. Future additions (animation tick, focus state, viewport bounds) can be added as record fields without breaking element implementations.

  • Method Details

    • hasMouseInput

      public boolean hasMouseInput()
      Returns whether mouse input is present in this render pass. HUDs return false; inventory menus and standalone screens return true.

    • isHovered

      public boolean isHovered(int childX, int childY, int width, int height)
      Tests whether the mouse is over a bounded region within this context's content origin. Returns false when no input dispatch is present (HUDs), regardless of mouse coordinates.
      Parameters:
      childX - element's X position relative to the content origin
      childY - element's Y position relative to the content origin
      width - element's width in pixels
      height - element's height in pixels
